environmentIncidents.attempt: Initial full desktop npm test without exporting JDK 21
environmentIncidents.detail: Eight unrelated Java fixture tests invoked system javac 17 with --release 21; rerunning with JAVA_HOME and PATH set to Temurin 21 passed all 99 tests.

environmentIncidents.attempt: Initial packaged E2E on Ubuntu 24.04 with the default packaged chrome-sandbox ownership/mode
environmentIncidents.detail: Electron aborted because chrome-sandbox was runner:runner mode 0755. Setting the ignored local package helper to root:root mode 4755, without disabling the Chromium sandbox, allowed all 9 curriculum E2E tests to pass.
